A 10-year history of Colorado's budget

cobud_history.Rd

Historical data describing Colorado's General Fund budget going back to FY 2015-16. These are all the fields used by and forecasted in cobud_forecast(). Assembled by the LCS economics team and contained in the LCS economic forecasts. See cobud - Colorado's Budget Forecast Tool and Budget Fields for more details.

Usage

cobud_history

Format

cobud_history
